sections.section_title: 12.7 Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) 1.1 Criteria for Evaluating Response in Solid Tumors
sections.content: The KEYNOTE-024 SAP references RECIST 1.1 criteria in section 12.7 but the actual RECIST derivation tables are not included in the provided pages. The document mentions this section exists but the content was not provided in the extract.

sections.section_title: Table 4: Overall Visit Responses - RECIST 1.1 Response Derivation
sections.content:
Table 4 defines how Target Lesions (TL), Non-target lesions (NTL), and New Lesions are combined to give an overall visit response:

Target Lesions | Non-target lesions | New Lesions | Overall Response
CR | CR | No | CR
CR | NA | No | CR
NA | CR | No | CR
CR | Non CR/Non PD | No | PR
CR | NE | No | PR
PR | Non PD or NE | No | PR
SD | Non PD or NE | No | SD
NA | Non CR/Non PD | No | SD (Non CR/Non PD)
NE | Non PD or NE | No | NE
NA | NE | No | NE
PD | Any | Yes or No | PD
Any | PD | Yes or No | PD
Any | Any | Yes | PD
NA | NA | No | NED

Where CR = complete response, PR = partial response, SD = stable disease, PD = progressive disease, NE = not evaluable, NED = no evidence of disease, NA = not applicable (only relevant if there were no TL/NTL at baseline).
key_numbers: 15 mm short axis for lymph nodes

sections.section_title: Table 2: TL Visit Responses and Table 3: NTL Visit Responses
sections.content:
Table 2 - TL Visit Responses:
Complete Response (CR): Disappearance of all TLs since baseline. Any pathological lymph nodes selected as TLs must have a reduction in short axis to <10 mm
Partial Response (PR): At least a 30% decrease in the sum of diameters of TL, taking as reference the baseline sum of diameters as long as criteria for PD are not met.
Progressive Disease (PD): At least a 20% increase in the sum of diameters of TLs taking as reference the smallest sum on study. In addition to the relative increase of 20%, the sum must also indicate an absolute increase of at least 5 mm
Stable Disease (SD): Neither sufficient shrinkage to qualify for PR nor sufficient increase to qualify for PD

Table 3 - NTL Visit Responses:
Complete Response (CR): Disappearance of all NTLs present at baseline with all lymph nodes non-pathological in size (<10 mm short axis).
Progression (PD): Unequivocal progression of existing NTLs.
Non-CR/Non-PD: Persistence of one or more NTLs with no evidence of progression.

summary: Found comprehensive RECIST response derivation tables in PACIFIC SAP. Table 4 provides the complete Target Lesion + Non-Target Lesion + New Lesion → Overall Response mapping with all CR/PR/SD/PD combinations. Tables 2 and 3 provide the detailed criteria for individual target lesion and non-target lesion responses with specific numerical thresholds (30% decrease for PR, 20% increase + 5mm absolute increase for PD). KEYNOTE-024 and KEYNOTE-042 reference RECIST 1.1 criteria but the actual derivation tables were not included in the provided pages. Lung-MAP SAP did not contain RECIST derivation tables.
